subject: MLB MVP Award
query: who has the most mvp awards in mlb history
title: Who has the most MVP awards in MLB history? Bonds, then Ohtani
answer: Barry Bonds has the most MVP awards in MLB history with seven (1990, 1992, 1993 and 2001-2004). Shohei Ohtani is second with four (2021, 2023, 2024 and 2025). Ohtani is a 2026 NL MVP finalist, and the winners will be announced on Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026.
body:
Eleven players have won exactly three MVP awards, according to MLB.com: Aaron Judge (2022, 2024, 2025), Mike Trout (2014, 2016, 2019), Albert Pujols (2005, 2008, 2009), Alex Rodriguez (2003, 2005, 2007), Mike Schmidt (1980, 1981, 1986), Mickey Mantle (1956, 1957, 1962), Yogi Berra (1951, 1954, 1955), Roy Campanella (1951, 1953, 1955), Stan Musial (1943, 1946, 1948), Joe DiMaggio (1939, 1941, 1947) and Jimmie Foxx (1932, 1933, 1938).

Ohtani has won the MVP in each of the past three seasons. He and Frank Robinson are the only players to win MVP in both leagues, and Ohtani is the only one with more than one MVP in each league. The 2026 NL finalists are Ohtani, Pete Crow-Armstrong (Cubs) and Brice Turang (Brewers). The AL finalists are Yordan Alvarez (Astros), Junior Caminero (Rays) and Bobby Witt Jr. (Royals).

The MVP is voted on by the Baseball Writers' Association of America, and ballots are cast before the postseason begins.
in_the_news: MLB announces the 2026 AL and NL MVP winners on Nov. 12, 2026; Ohtani is a finalist for a fifth MVP.

faq.q: How many MVPs does Shohei Ohtani have?
faq.a: Four: 2021 and 2023 in the American League with the Angels, and 2024 and 2025 in the National League with the Dodgers.

faq.q: How many MVPs does Barry Bonds have?
faq.a: Seven, the most ever, including four in a row from 2001 to 2004.
AL: Yordan Alvarez, Junior Caminero, Bobby Witt Jr. NL: Pete Crow-Armstrong, Shohei Ohtani, Brice Turang.
